text: Operator training simulator (OTS): a high-fidelity, whole-plant simulator (ER-12.06) that contains the same DCS graphics and control functions (emulated controllers or the hardware of the DCS) and the TCS logic (or a validated model), with dynamic models of the GT, HRSG, ST, condenser, cycle, cooling water, water treatment, fuel systems and the electrical system; instructor station with malfunction, snapshot, replay and scenario functions; the specification is ALP-EPC-00CKA-GE-SPC-0001.
